item.title: Legally Validated Evaluation Framework for Voice Anonymization
item.description:
Code. The reference implementation of both metrics is open source as voice-anonymization-legal-eval (pip install voice-anonymization-legal-eval), with the score matrices and dataset definitions on Zenodo.

On the CNIL’s role, stated precisely. In August 2024 the Technological Expertise Department of the CNIL, the French data protection authority, reviewed Nijta’s Voice Harbor solution and identified no obstacle to it demonstrating compliance with the three anonymization criteria of Article 29 Working Party Opinion 05/2014. These metrics were the vehicle of that demonstration. It is a technical opinion on a solution, not a certification of the metrics, and it does not transfer to an organisation deploying the solution, which must demonstrate anonymity in its own context.
